reconcile.note: Keil and Delitzsch attribute Bashemath's differing fathers to the ancient custom of renaming brides, with Moses preserving divergent genealogical sources unaltered.

sides.snippet: Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.
sides.verseText: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.

sides.snippet: Basemath, Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
sides.verseText: and Basemath, Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
